subject: Ensino Religioso
description_pt: Reconhecer a importância da tradição oral para preservar memórias e acontecimentos religiosos.

components.description_pt: Reconhecer a tradição oral como meio de preservação de memórias religiosas entre gerações
components.description_en: Recognize oral tradition as a means of preserving religious memories across generations

components.description_pt: Identificar exemplos de eventos religiosos transmitidos por tradição oral em diferentes culturas
components.description_en: Identify examples of religious events transmitted through oral tradition in different cultures
components.cc_component_description: Analyze how different cultures portray similar topics in myths and traditional literature

components.description_pt: Explicar o papel da tradição oral na manutenção da identidade religiosa coletiva
components.description_en: Explain the role of oral tradition in maintaining collective religious identity

components.description_pt: Comparar a tradição oral a formas escritas de preservação do conhecimento religioso
components.description_en: Compare oral tradition to written forms of preserving religious knowledge

cc_matches.description: Compare and contrast the treatment of similar themes and topics (e.g., opposition of good and evil) and patterns of events (e.g., the quest) in stories, myths, and traditional literature from different cultures.
